name: dca-factory
description: Delivery pipeline for DCA projects: a markdown backlog contract (epics with intent, goal, outcome-event metric and domain contact; stories with keyed acceptance criteria), the stage skills plan/test/build/tidy/judge/document with one hand-over file each, factory-backlog to write the backlog and factory-scope for the questions a run may not answer itself, factory-verify to check the pipeline itself against throwaway fixtures, and a dependency-free story gate that checks epic completeness, one red-then-green end-user test per criterion, the architecture suite and the documentation claims. Portable by rule: skill folders and one script, so Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode run the same pipeline. Carries no architecture method and no project knowledge — those stay in dca-core and in the project's stack profile.
